# CircuitTopologyFitnessLandscape

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A mapping of circuit design performance metrics across the space of possible interconnect topologies, used to guide evolutionary search. Provides a structured basis for optimizing TCC topologies, allowing quantitative comparison of candidate designs and informed speciation.
